definition: Exaltation is a state contrasted with depression in which thinking feels speeded up and imagination becomes highly active, often aimed at grand or elevated ideas. In a broader historical sense it can mean mental excitement generally; when excessive, it was used for abnormal states and for grandiose beliefs about one’s importance, power, wealth, or identity in mental disorder.
